title: Direct-sum computation and left exactness of presheaf element extension
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J, R a sheaf of rings and A a sheaf of sets, with element projection p and restricted ring R_A as in [lem-weil-pbc-element-module-extension-adjunction]. The presheaf module pullback Q=PresheafOfModules.pullback(identity (R_A).obj) along p preserves finite limits. For every R_A-module sheaf L [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], Q(L.val) is isomorphic as an R-module presheaf to elementDirectSumPresheaf(R,A,L), whose sections at U are the direct sum of L(U,s) over s in A(U), with a summand restricted through the lifted element arrow to the A(v)s summand.

proof.text: Construct the direct-sum presheaf on arbitrary module presheaves using its summand restrictions. A map from it into M is a family of linear maps from L(U,s) into M(U); the lifted element arrows identify the naturality equations with those of a map from L into restriction of M. Define both directions and check the inverse equations on summand inclusions. This gives a left adjoint to presheaf restriction. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies it with Mathlib presheaf pullback; specializing to a module sheaf gives the direct-sum formula. At each U, the explicit sum functor factors through the diagram of fibre evaluations followed by the discrete colimit functor. Fibre evaluations preserve finite limits, and coproducts of modules preserve finite limits by Mathlib exact coproducts. The coproduct-to-direct-sum isomorphism is natural, as checked on each summand. Therefore evaluation of extension preserves finite limits at every U. Joint reflection of limits by module-presheaf evaluations yields finite-limit preservation of the sum functor; transport across the adjoint uniqueness isomorphism gives it for presheaf pullback. These universal properties include empty fibres and the zero ring.

proof_origin.note: Direct-sum universal-property proof and sectionwise exact coproducts; the source argument is fully proved in Lean without a new sorry.
